text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I saw Zenno Rob Roy
aggressively pressing Agnes Digital...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: The paper, the ink, the spine, the binding... They're all so close to the materials and methods used back when it was first published. The quality is incredible...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hyoeee, what incredible insight...
I am utterly humbled and awestruck~~!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Digital-san's Trainer!
This is amazing, please take a look at this book...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"It's a reprint of an old novel,
and it was actually produced at Digital-san's family printing press...!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it was simply magnificent...!
I just had to come share my impressions with you.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
No, it was nothing, really...! But if you're
this passionate about it, I'm sure
my father would be delighted as well...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Yes, she's quite the perfectionist, you know~
It looked like she worked really hard on that book right from the planning stages.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Is that so... Fastidious, huh... That somehow sounds just like Digital-san's father!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that so?
Well, "getting totally obsessed with what you love!"
might just run in the family...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Like father, like daughter!
It's kind of like that, I guess—"

text_block_list.name: Digital's Father
text_block_list.text:
Yes! This exquisite matte texture...!
It's so easy to turn the pages!
Low show-through and glare make it so easy to read...!

text_block_list.name: Young Digital
text_block_list.text:
Dad, shouting like that in the office...
Is paper... really that interesting...?

text_block_list.name: Digital's Father
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, you're here?
Paper is amazing☆ Every single sheet has its own precious personality.
'No paper, no life,' I always say!

text_block_list.name: Digital's Mother
text_block_list.text: Fufu... It would be nice if you found something to be passionate about too, Digi. If you do, life is sure to be fun and precious♪

text_block_list.name: Young Digital
text_block_list.text: Hmm...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
TV
text_block_list.text:
—Mornings start early for a professional racer...
Even the day after a GⅠ defeat, she never breaks routine.
Tears glisten in her eyes as she does her early morning run.

text_block_list.name: Young Digital
text_block_list.text:
—Ngh...!
S-Such sheer nobility...!

text_block_list.name: Young Digital
text_block_list.text:
Haaaaahhh, wh-what is this...?
What on earth is this feeling...!?
It feels like my heart is being squeezed tight...!

text_block_list.name: Young Digital
text_block_list.text:
What's happening to me...!?
Da-Dad, Mommm~~!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
“—And then my parents bought me a bunch of books
and merch, and down the rabbit hole I went...”

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Geez, by the time I graduated elementary school, I was already a total Umamusume otaku...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: It's strange, isn't it? Were they really that happy that I found a hobby...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Life becoming fun is definitely
something I owe to my parents, yep.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Being able to dedicate yourself to something is a wonderful talent.
Your parents must have known that very well."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
They are wonderful parents...
Nurturing their child's passions like that.
choice_data_list: They really are a wonderful family, aren't they?
My hobbies helped me become versatile, too.
My hobbies helped me become versatile, too.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
They are wonderful parents...
Nurturing their child's passions like that.
choice_data_list: They really are a wonderful family, aren't they?
My hobbies helped me become versatile, too.
My hobbies helped me become versatile, too.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Oof, not you too, Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
B-But yeah, that's true... They're a wonderful family.
They really treasure the things I love...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, ehehehe...!
I-It makes me ticklish getting complimented by family!
Degitan is totally humbled!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I understand. Because Digital-san loves Umamusume racing so much, she's very knowledgeable, has sharp analysis, and knows racing history inside out.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, you're great at drawing and storytelling,
and you make your own doujinshi, right?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: "Guh-whoa!!? H-How do you know about that...?!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Um! W-Well, you know!
E-Even literary giants back in the day did doujinshi, right?~
Rob Roy, do you like Japanese literature?!
